content: Apple documents AVPlayerLayer.videoRect as the actual image rectangle depending on media ratio, layer bounds, and gravity. AVPlayerItemVideoOutput marks copied images acquired; use hasNewPixelBuffer and its returned display time rather than assuming a requested playhead time identifies the frame. Local iPhoneOS SDK AVPlayerItemOutput.h confirms the out parameter is the true display deadline. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayerlayer/videorect https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayeritemvideooutput
